name: Customization Volume Integration
aliases: Customization Volume Integration in Ray Casting
definition: A method to integrate a pre-computed customization volume into the volume rendering pipeline (e.g., ray casting) to apply position-dependent modifications to visualization parameters, such as gamma correction of intensity values.
summary: Customization Volume Integration applies position-dependent modifications to visualization parameters by integrating a pre-computed volume into the ray casting pipeline, differing from standard methods via an auxiliary data structure that modulates input data before classification.
